title: Agent Pulse
description: One daily evidence-backed decision brief from the coding-agent projects monitored by The Git Reporter.

scope.coverageStatement: V0.2 reports one dated decision brief from direct public source evidence and keeps git motion as a secondary measurement layer. Community feedback metrics are absent until a reproducible feedback collector ships.

inputs.dailyInsight: reported, date-owned Agent Pulse decision brief

editorialRead.headline: Morning Read — October 5, 2026
editorialRead.readHeadline: different-ai/openwork is the first source to inspect.
editorialRead.oneLineSummary: different-ai/openwork leads a 3-item attention queue backed by direct receipts; 29 watchlist sources are fresh, 0 need source-health attention, and movement still requires editorial judgment.
editorialRead.dek: Agent Pulse filtered 29 included projects down to 3 items worth finite newsroom attention. The queue protects attention; it does not declare winners.
bullets: different-ai/openwork — 3 commits today and 1 same-day mapped article, 24.4 below its current daily pace, with 1 hardening-subject points. Inspect the receipt before assigning a story.
openclaw/openclaw — 84 commits landed today. Keep it on watch, but require the next receipt to prove a reader consequence before promoting it.
yc-software/qm — No same-day commit after 100 commits in the seven-day window. The pause is notable enough to preserve, not enough to turn into a story.
editorialRead.watchNext: The next meaningful upgrade is feedback flow: issues opened and closed, review latency, stale backlog, and the share of work that starts outside the maintainer team.
editorialRead.caveat: Source-code motion and article coverage are collected. GitHub issue flow, PR review timing, community discussion, and private backlog signals are not.

dailyInsight.headline: Preview which Cowork instructions can travel to OpenWork
dailyInsight.insight: OpenWork has published a migration command for plugin discovery, preview and import. Personal Cowork instructions can be carried into a new setup, with supporting files and service access handled separately.
dailyInsight.mechanism: The CLI reads local marketplace and skill manifests. The inspected backend permits reading Claude-style skill instructions before optional connector setup. Personal-skill upload reads SKILL.md text, not its directory; existing plugin access is preserved on repeat import.
dailyInsight.whyItMatters: People considering another assistant can inspect what is portable before rebuilding their setup or moving a real recurring task.

actions.label: Inspect one text-only procedure first
actions.instruction: Use the published migration guide to inspect the scan and preview for one non-sensitive instruction-only skill. Check supporting-file needs and initial sharing choices before any import. Then test one disposable task after separately connecting the services it requires.
actions.effort: One preview and a small task trial

receipts.title: Migration CLI and source-defined discovery/import journey
receipts.supports: Adds discovery, preview and import. The publicly downloadable command matched this source; a synthetic discovery check passed.

receipts.title: Instruction access before optional connector setup
receipts.supports: Marks Claude-style connector requirements optional, returns their setup states with instruction text and defines bounded repeat-import behavior.

receipts.title: Migration guide for the public command
receipts.supports: Defines the public command distribution and staged migration workflow. Our separate download comparison and synthetic discovery check are documented in the linked article; authenticated transfer remains untested.

confidence.basis: Pinned source, public CLI byte comparison and synthetic discovery agree. Authenticated import and downstream tasks were not independently executed.

dailyInsight.limitation: The live CLI does not verify deployed backend behavior. Skill instruction text can move without supporting files; connector-dependent tasks still need authorization. Repeat import is not two-way synchronization.
dailyInsight.falsifier: A real import that fails to preserve a supported text-only skill or withholds its instructions solely for an optional disconnected connector would narrow this reading.
dailyInsight.watchNext: A public migration carrying required files and completing the same representative task after connector setup.
